Social media in Vienna: you work, we post.

A profile where nothing has happened for months looks like a closed shop. We make sure there is regularly something new to see on yours.

Send a request

Who is this for?

For businesses in Vienna who know their customers are on Instagram and Facebook but have no time for it in day-to-day work. Regular posts show that something is happening: new offers, a look behind the scenes, opening hours before public holidays. We take on the work and you keep control — nothing goes online without your approval.

What you get

  • Profile setupInstagram and Facebook set up properly: name, picture, description, contact and a link to your website.
  • A plan, not chanceTogether we decide what gets posted and how often — in a way that fits your business.
  • Posts, carousels, reelsWe design the content in one consistent style so people recognise you at once.
  • Ongoing careWe publish regularly and keep your profile up to date.

How it works

  1. Message usYou tell us which channels you have or want.
  2. PlanYou get a proposal for topics, style and rhythm.
  3. GoWe create and publish — you approve first.

Common questions

Do I need both Instagram and Facebook?

Not necessarily. What matters is the channel your customers use. We work that out together.

Do I have to supply photos myself?

Photos and short videos from your business help a lot — they make it real. How we get them is settled at the start.

What does it cost?

That depends on the scope. Tell us briefly what you need and we will send you a quote.
